```yaml
name: Clean Unused Strings

on:
  schedule:
    # Run at 00:00 on the 1st of every month
    - cron: '0 0 1 * *'
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      force:
        description: 'Force cleanup even if no changes detected'
        required: false
        default: false
        type: boolean

permissions:
  contents: write
  pull-requests: write

jobs:
  clean-unused-strings:
    runs-on: macos-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Set up Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: '3.11'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          python -m pip install --upgrade pip
          # Install any required dependencies for the scripts if they have requirements.txt
          if [ -f Tools/requirements.txt ]; then
            pip install -r Tools/requirements.txt
          fi

      - name: Run detection script
        id: detect
        run: |
          python Tools/detect_unused_strings.py > unused_strings_report.txt
          echo "Report generated:"
          cat unused_strings_report.txt
          # Extract count of unused strings for conditional logic
          UNUSED_COUNT=$(grep -c "^-" unused_strings_report.txt || echo "0")
          echo "unused_count=$UNUSED_COUNT" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT

      - name: Run removal script
        if: steps.detect.outputs.unused_count != '0' || inputs.force == 'true'
        run: |
          python Tools/remove_unused_strings.py

      - name: Regenerate Strings.swift
        if: steps.detect.outputs.unused_count != '0' || inputs.force == 'true'
        run: |
          # Assuming SwiftGen is available or installed via brew in the runner
          # If SwiftGen needs installation, add: brew install swiftgen
          swiftgen strings config --config ./Tools/SwiftGen.yml

      - name: Create Pull Request
        if: steps.detect.outputs.unused_count != '0' || inputs.force == 'true'
        uses: peter-evans/create-pull-request@v7
        with:
          token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          commit-message: "chore: remove unused localization strings"
          title: "chore: remove unused localization strings"
          body: |
            This PR removes unused localization strings detected by the automated cleanup workflow.
            
            **Changes:**
            - Removed unused keys from `*.lproj/Localizable.strings` files
            - Regenerated `Strings.swift` via SwiftGen
            
            **Details:**
            See the detection report for specific strings removed.
          branch: "chore/clean-unused-strings"
          delete-branch: true
          labels: |
            automation
            maintenance
```
